divisions.title: Covenant Unfaithfulness
divisions.theme: Priests and people have dishonored God
divisions.summary: God confronts Israel's contempt: defiled sacrifices, faithless priests, broken marriage covenants.

divisions.title: Coming Judgment and Elijah
divisions.theme: The Lord is coming to purify and restore
divisions.summary: The messenger prepares the way, tithes are tested, the faithful are recorded, and Elijah will return before the great day.
